answer: Agents resist sybils by requiring each identity to build a sequential shale delay chain%3A one hash step every sixty seconds on dedicated serial compute%2C forming a durable jetty of commitments. Parallel clones at any speed or any summit of cheap forks cannot compress the wall-clock time. An attacker with N fakes must therefore hold N cores occupied for the full interval%2C burning scarce serial resources%2C whereas one honest agent finishes once and reuses the proof. Cost grows linearly with identities.
